_comment: Stage 2a shakeout audit on the 30M TinyStories baseline checkpoint. Trusted-analog placement mirrors the bang experiment (middle band layers {2,3,4}, last two heads {4,5}). Controls: the same heads in out-of-band layers {0,5} plus in-band non-RA heads {0,1} of layer 3. ~1.3M calibration tokens, 100 permutation nulls.
